subject: Coordination: joint CPPO demo + preflight evidence for CloudResell

Subject: Intro + CPPO joint demo & security evidence request

Hi Aditya / Ben,

Thanks again for the overview last week. Acme (Leah) is excited about the CPPO path but procurement flagged a couple of asks before they can commit to the reseller PO flow:

1) A short joint demo (30–40m) showing expected customer UX when buying through our private offer.
2) A security/compliance evidence pack (SOC2 scope, data residency notes, DB retention, KMS integration checklist) to feed procurement.
3) DocuSign routing expectations for a two-party reseller PO + customer order flow.

Can we schedule the demo week of Dec 13? Also please send a single-page evidence checklist we can hand to Acme procurement.

Attachments: none in this message.

Samir — thanks for the clear asks. We can do the demo and assemble an evidence checklist. Proposed plan: 

- Demo: 30m joint session + 10m buffer for procurement Q&A. I can run the CPPO flow (Redwood hosted catalog -> CPPO offer -> reseller entitlement) and Ben will demo the entitlement mapping in the portal.
- Evidence pack: Naomi will prepare a one-page checklist + links to SOC2 report excerpt, KMS integration doc, and retention policy.
- DocuSign: Irene will outline typical routing and a sample routing diagram for a reseller PO + customer order.

Availability: Dec 14 or Dec 15, 10:00–11:00 PT works for our core team. Do either of those work for Acme?

I'll attach a draft agenda and a short evidence checklist stub in a follow-up.

Attachments: joint-demo-agenda-v1.docx (DOCX)

Best,
Aditya Rao

Looping in a few quick notes for the demo and evidence that Acme is likely to ask for — pulling from recent CPPO plays: 

- Demo checklist: show SKU mapping, entitlement split (reseller vs customer billing), and a failover when PPO entitlement fails (fallback to hosted SKU).
- Evidence to include: SOC2 in-scope controls (link), KMS/HSM confirmation for key rotation cadence, sample audit log export (timestamp + request id), and our standard DPA excerpt (data residency lines).
- Procurement tip: have the reseller provide a single payer entity and confirm invoice remit entity; that'll help Marketplace billing team with the PO mapping.

I attached an evidence checklist PDF I usually send to resellers for initial procurement screens. Naomi — please update the doc with the Redwood-specific KMS lines and retention windows.

Attachments: redwood-cppo-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF)

- Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference

- Attachments provided: redwood-cppo-evidence-checklist.pdf (short checklist + links to SOC2 excerpt, DPA, KMS notes) and joint-demo-agenda-v1.docx.
